title: Get Revision
description: Gets information about a specific Cloud Run revision.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to retrieve details for a particular revision within a Cloud Run service. Revisions are immutable snapshots of your service's code and configuration, created automatically when a service is updated.
